title: Meta and Microsoft take steps to reduce employee usage of Claude AI
hook_text: Meta and Microsoft scale back Claude
script:
Meta and Microsoft are taking steps to reduce employee usage of Claude AI.
The restriction involves the rival AI created by Anthropic.
Would your company restrict competing AI tools?
